title: Enhancement of electrocaloric response and elevated energy-storage characteristics in lead-free BCTZ-ZN ceramics
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24639-24647
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08946D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hanen Abdmouleh, Issa Kriaa, Najmeddine Abdelmoula, Zina Sassi, Hamadi Khemakhem
Lead-free BCTZ-xZN ceramics enable cooling & energy storage. We report that BCTZ-2.5ZN is ideal for eco-friendly electronics, with a peak electrocaloric response of 0.68 K at 340 K, Wrec = 150 mJ cm−3 (η = 83%), ΔS = 1.14 J kg K−1, and COP = 2.
